sources.title: Day 0 Support for Gemma 4 on AMD Processors and GPUs
sources.snippet: Developers will be able to deploy Gemma 4 models on NPU by integrating Lemonade Server, which supports the latest AMD XDNA 2 NPU. NPU support for the Gemma-4 E2B and E4B models will arrive with the next Ryzen AI SW update.
